description: This file defines device configurations for the build system targeting an Airoha AN7583 evaluation board. It specifies kernel build steps, device-specific parameters, and packaging instructions for different hardware variants.

methods.name: Device/FitImageLzma
methods.description: A build step definition for creating a LZMA compressed FIT image, used as a template for device images.

methods.name: Device/airoha_an7583-evb
methods.description: Defines configuration for the AN7583 Evaluation Board (SNAND), including device-specific parameters and image build instructions.

methods.name: Device/airoha_an7583-evb-emmc
methods.description: Defines configuration for the EMMC variant of the AN7583 Evaluation Board.
